description: Source file implementing PlatformCapsData class with methods for retrieving device info via JSON-RPC calls, including model, device type, HDR capabilities, account ID, device ID, session token, experience, MAC address, and public IP. Contains internal helper functions and RPC client management.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData
classes.description: Class providing methods to retrieve platform-specific device information via JSON-RPC.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc
classes.description: Nested class managing JSON-RPC client interactions, including invoking methods and activating clients.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc::ClientProxy
classes.description: Proxy class representing a JSON-RPC client connection.

methods.name: stringFromHex
methods.description: Helper function converting hex string to ASCII string.

methods.description: Retrieves device type, conditionally compiled based on ENABLE_COMMUNITY_DEVICE_TYPE.

methods.name: PlatformCapsData::GetHDRCapability
methods.description: Retrieves HDR support standards as a comma-separated string.

methods.name: PlatformCapsData::XCALSessionTokenAvailable

methods.description: Performs a JSON-RPC call with specified method and wait time.
